newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Analysts disappointed by Nestle results.
newsitem.headline: Analysts disappointed by Nestle results.

text.p: Swiss analysts said they expected Nestle SA shares to meet selling pressure on news that its trading profit rose only marginally in the first half of 1996.
James Amoroso, an analyst at CS Investment Research in Zurich, said he was considering reducing his estimate that Nestle would post 1996 earnings per share of 84.3 Swiss francs.
"Now 84.3 is in danger," he said after being briefed by company officials in a conference call with analysts.
"I will keep my neutral rating relative to the Swiss market, but in the short term prices will continue to come under pressure," he said.
